Wrangler Air in Hammond 1591C

Stock Hammond 1591CBK 120 × 65 × 40 mm (sizes from the Hammond drawing). The red parts are the two lid bosses to cut off under the DinMeter, standing upright with the lid against the tunnel wall. DinMeter in the upper end wall (short side), screen up; relay and ADC flat on the box bottom; wire slot in the lower end wall. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
